sentences.en: He ran on and on, until he was completely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 他一直跑个不停，直到筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: At last, I brought her exhausted body upon the beach.
sentences.zh: 最后，我将她疲惫不堪的身体带到了海滩上。

sentences.en: I tried harder than usual, so I'm all the more exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我比平时更加努力了，所以现在更觉得筋疲力尽。

senses.zh: 筋疲力尽的，疲惫不堪的；耗尽的，枯竭的
使……精疲力尽；耗尽，用尽；详尽讨论（exhaust 的过去式和过去分词）
